svg.title: Baseline J01-J04: domain model (records, catalogue, list)

g.text: Baseline J01-J04: domain model (records, catalogue, list)
whole catalogue, then replace. On invalid
or empty input keep the last accepted
catalogue. Keyed by code, so a repeated
price is nullable: missing price is
unknown, never zero, and never wins
checked state - the list survives a
restart (J04) and does not copy prices.
